recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色（紅色色原）顯示一片界線不清、斜向分佈的陽性細胞聚集區，周圍則是較疏散的陽性細胞，整體結節邊界模糊；這種不規則、擴散的分佈可對應 NLPHL 變異型態，但抗原未標示，需配合其他染色判讀。
features: Low-power field of a lymphoid proliferation with a poorly circumscribed, band-like aggregate of densely positive cells
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with membranous/cytoplasmic red chromogen
Numerous scattered positive cells extend into the surrounding negative lymphoid background
No well-formed, sharply delineated nodules in this field
Individual large-cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled) of a lymph node shows an irregular, poorly delineated aggregate of positive small to medium-sized cells with numerous positive cells scattered in the surrounding lymphoid tissue. Distinct, well-formed nodules are not apparent in this field. In the context of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, the ill-defined, expansile distribution may reflect a variant growth pattern; cytologic detail is not resolvable at this magnification, and interpretation depends on the antigen and the companion stains of the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have sharply demarcated germinal centers with intact mantle zones, whereas this field shows an ill-defined, disrupted aggregate.
THRLBCL lacks residual small-B-cell nodules and FDC meshworks; loss of all nodular B-cell compartments would favor THRLBCL over variant NLPHL.
PTGC forms large but round, well-defined nodules without atypical LP cells.
